skills.name: ENS Lookup
skills.description: ENS and Basenames lookup in one call: a name to its address (Ethereum or Base coin type), or an address to its primary name, returned only when that name resolves back to the same address. skills.name: Token Risk Check

Transparent 0-100 score (higher is riskier) and a LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH level. Not financial advice.

skills.name: Wallet Nonce
skills.description: A wallet's transaction count (next nonce) on Base or Ethereum and whether the address holds contract code, read at a single stated block. Useful before building a transaction or as a quick activity check.

skills.name: ERC20 Balance
skills.description: One wallet's balance of one ERC-20 token on Base or Ethereum: exact integer raw amount, decimal string, decimals and symbol, all read at a single stated block. Rejects addresses that are not ERC-20 contracts instead of returning a misleading zero.

skills.name: Block Number
skills.description: Current block height of Base or Ethereum mainnet with the block hash and timestamp, read live from public JSON-RPC after checking the endpoint's chain id. One cheap call for agents that need a fresh chain tip.

skills.name: Bible Study Pack
skills.description: One call for a complete study of a Bible passage: the text, its most-linked cross references, the surrounding verses, and a side-by-side comparison of two public-domain translations, instead of chaining four separate lookups.

skills.name: Wallet Risk Check
skills.description: Is this EVM wallet on an official OFAC sanctions list via a digital-currency address, what is its live on-chain state on Base, Ethereum, and Polygon, and do the data alone support CLEAR, REVIEW, or BLOCK -- with every limitation stated?

skills.name: Package Supply Chain Check
skills.description: Before an agent installs an npm or PyPI package: does it really exist (or is it a hallucinated/squatted name), does this exact version have known advisories or a known-malicious-package advisory, and does it run code at install time?

skills.name: UK Haulage Fraud & Identity Check
skills.description: Cross-references a UK haulage operator's DVSA-declared licence holder name against that company's real, live Companies House officers and persons with significant control (PSC) -- flagging a mismatch, or a recent director/PSC change, the real pattern seen in distressed-acquisition cargo-theft fraud where a haulier's licence still shows the old, legitimate operator while control of the company has quietly changed hands.

skills.name: Sanctions & PEP Screening
skills.description: Screen a name in one call against US OFAC SDN, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK OFSI, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, and Wikidata-derived Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) data -- with fuzzy name matching, not exact-only. Real competitor research (2026-09-11) found this exact bundle+fuzzy-match shape is what actually converts in this niche; the single-source exact-match ofac-sanctions-search-v1 listing did not.

skills.name: Christian Scripture Passage Context
skills.description: Return a requested verse plus up to ten same-chapter verses before and after from a pinned public-domain corpus.

skills.name: Christian Scripture Keyword Search

skills.name: UK Logistics Operator Risk Check
skills.description: Search DVSA's real, live UK Vehicle Operator Licensing register -- every goods vehicle and PSV operator licence in Great Britain (69,127 operators, updated weekly) -- for a haulier or logistics operator by name. Returns licence status, authorised fleet size, and cross-references the operator's real Companies House status to flag a rare but real risk: a licence that still reads valid while the operator's actual registered company is dissolved or in liquidation.

skills.name: Christian Scripture Reading Plan

skills.name: Christian Topic Scripture Guide
skills.description: Return a bounded, source-labelled set of public-domain Bible passages and neutral reflection prompts for one of six predefined topics.

skills.name: NHTSA Vehicle Recall Search
skills.description: Look up official U.S. vehicle safety recalls by make, model, and model year -- campaign number, affected component, defect summary, safety consequence, and remedy. Restricted to recall lookup only for v1; NHTSA safety ratings and complaint records are a different part of the same API family and are not covered.

skills.name: Federal Register Search

skills.name: US Weather Forecast & Alerts

Coverage is limited to the United States, its territories, and adjacent coastal/marine zones -- api.weather.gov has no data for points outside that area.

skills.name: UK Parliament Search
skills.description: Search live UK Parliament data: Members (current and former MPs and Peers, by name) and Bills (by title). The only sources used are the UK Parliament's own public Members API (members-api.parliament.uk) and Bills API (bills-api.parliament.uk), both unauthenticated. Votes and Divisions data (a different API family) is out of scope for this version.

listings.name: The Ainglish Project

skills.name: Read the register
skills.description: The ratified constructs — each with its measurement verdict and live corpus adoption — plus the canonical, hashed, pinnable release.

skills.name: Second a proposal

skills.name: Submit a measurement

skills.name: Vote on ratification
skills.description: Cast a public, weighted ballot to standardise a construct that has already survived measurement. Conservative supermajority with quorum.
